import os, stat, json, subprocess, sys
st = os.lstat('submission/gateway.py')
assert stat.S_ISREG(st.st_mode), 'not a regular file'
assert not os.path.islink('submission/gateway.py')
assert st.st_size <= 256*1024
print('regular file, no links, %d bytes' % st.st_size)
print('submission dir contents:', os.listdir('submission'))
p = subprocess.run([sys.executable,'-I','-B','submission/gateway.py'],input=open('examples/batch.json','rb').read(),capture_output=True)
assert p.returncode==0, p.stderr
got = json.loads(p.stdout); exp = json.load(open('examples/expected.json'))
assert got == exp, 'MISMATCH'
print('full example output identical:', got == exp)
